name: Bistro & Café
tagline: A menu-driven site for a restaurant, café, or bakery.
description: A warm, photo-forward site for a restaurant or café. The menu is a Markdown content collection grouped by course, with hours, location, and a reservations call-to-action. A good showcase of content models and the image pipeline.

name: Summit Heating & Cooling
tagline: Reliable HVAC repair and installation, backed by 24/7 service.
description: A polished starter for a residential heating-and-cooling contractor, with a content-collection services grid, trust and testimonial sections, and prominent free-quote calls to action. Includes home, services, about, and contact pages plus a quote-request form.
features: Services grid powered by a content collection
Prominent "Get a Free Quote" CTAs and quote form
Customer testimonials and Licensed / Insured / 24-7 trust bar

name: Rivertown Foundation
description: A warm, hopeful starter for a local community nonprofit, built around a programs content collection, impact stats, and a prominent Donate call-to-action. Includes home, programs, about, get-involved (volunteer + donation tiers), and contact pages.

name: Craft & Code Academy
tagline: Become a web developer in 14 weeks.
description: A project-based online coding bootcamp with live mentorship and six guided modules. Features an interactive curriculum accordion, FAQ, and a clear enrollment path from first commit to a deployed full-stack capstone.

name: Flowlark
tagline: Plan, ship, and scale in one place.
description: A modern software product landing site with an interactive monthly/annual pricing toggle and an expandable FAQ accordion. Includes a feature grid, comparison table, logo cloud, and testimonials — all as plain Jx files.

name: Horizon Conf 2026
tagline: A landing site for a one-day tech and design conference.
description: A bold, gradient-driven site for a one-day conference, with a sessions content collection and a reactive agenda-tabs island that filters the schedule by track in real time. Showcases interactive islands, content models, pricing tiers, and a countdown-style save-the-date band.

name: The Long Field
tagline: Slow essays on design, technology, and craft.
description: A personal, editorial blog template with a Markdown posts collection, dynamic article routes, and tags. Built for writers who want a fast, readable publication with a dedicated reading layout and a newsletter CTA.
features: Dynamic article routes (one page per post)

name: Aperture Studio
tagline: Light, patience, and a good eye.
description: An image-forward photography and creative studio portfolio. Features a masonry project gallery, a Markdown-backed projects collection, and dynamic per-project case-study pages with cover, writeup, and gallery.
features: Masonry project gallery with hover-zoom cards
Dynamic per-project detail pages from a content collection

name: Ember Yoga & Fitness
tagline: Boutique yoga, pilates & strength for every body.
description: A boutique yoga and fitness studio site with a weekly class schedule, flexible membership pricing, and online booking. Small-class, all-levels branding backed by a content-driven schedule, a side-by-side membership comparison table, and a styled booking form.

name: Meridian Advisory
tagline: Numbers that move the business forward.
description: A boutique accounting and advisory firm site for founders and growing companies, with services, a team roster, and an insights library. Adapts cleanly for law and consulting practices with two layouts and per-article dynamic pages.
features: Insights collection with dynamic per-article pages
Team roster, services grid, and trust strip

name: Cadence Cycles
description: A neighborhood bike shop selling road, mountain, gravel, and kids' bikes plus gear and expert service. Features a filterable product grid with an interactive category island and dynamic per-product detail pages.

name: Northshore Realty
tagline: Search homes on the north shore.
description: A residential real-estate agency starter with a CSV-driven property listings collection and dynamic per-listing detail pages. Its split search hero, neighborhood tiles, and an interactive sidebar filter island update results instantly, no page reloads.
features: Split search hero + sidebar filter island
Dynamic per-listing detail pages with gallery
